headline: ほどけるリボンとID診断面をLOD演出にする
headlineEn: Turning unraveling ribbons and ID diagnostic planes into LOD-driven visuals
summary: Codrops の Infinite Loom と Liquid Glass、PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.1 / v2.22.0、Babylon.js 9.26.0、three.js の WebXR single-pass / WebGL multiview 議論を調査した。前回の liquid glass / readback 診断面を、今日は「画像を分割してほどく」「SOG LOD の空レベルや粗密を演出状態にする」「object ID / USD / stream diagnostics を表現に戻す」方向へ進め、依存なし WebGL 試作を2本追加した。
summaryEn: Today covers Codrops' Infinite Loom and Liquid Glass, PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.1 / v2.22.0, Babylon.js 9.26.0, and three.js WebXR single-pass / WebGL multiview discussions. Building on yesterday's liquid glass and readback diagnostic planes, the focus shifts to splitting images into unraveling ribbons, turning SOG LOD empty/coarse states into visual material, and returning object ID / USD / stream diagnostics to expression. Two dependency-free WebGL prototypes were added.

sections.title: 今日の重要トピック
sections.body: 1. Codrops の 2026-09-05 Infinite Loom は、画像を1枚の平面ではなく独立した水平リボン群として扱い、端へ行くほどずれ、ほどけ、白へ抜ける。前回の liquid glass が「平面に厚みを持たせる」話だったなら、これは「平面を別々の時間を持つ繊維に分解する」話。2. PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.1 は 2026-09-08 公開で、Gsplat LOD の coarse data がない node の empty level と distance default を修正している。v2.22.0 の error-driven GSplat LOD、streamed GSplat の per-splat detail falloff、SceneDepthReader と合わせると、SOG の粗密・空レベル・読み込み進捗を表現入力にできる。3. Babylon.js 9.26.0 は 2026-09-10 公開で、OpenUSD WebAssembly scene loader、object ID geometry textures、Gaussian splatting stream diagnostics in Inspector V2 を含む。これは「アセットの由来」「選択ID」「stream health」を画面上の素材へ戻す方向と相性がよい。4. three.js #34153 は WebGPU XR の single-pass rendering で tone mapping / output color-space conversion を inline にする議論、#34147 は WebGL fallback 側の multiview provider / attachment の議論。どちらも XR で片目ごとの追加パス、resolve、attachment をどう減らすかという話として、今日の ribbon / LOD 表現に接続できる。5. Codrops Liquid Glass は引き続き重要で、SDF glass、video refraction、MSDF label deformation、GPU cloth という流れが、今日のリボン分割やID診断面に厚みを与える背景になる。
sections.bodyEn: 1. Codrops' September 5 Infinite Loom treats each image as independent horizontal ribbons rather than a single plane, letting them offset, unravel, and fade to white near the viewport edges. If yesterday's liquid glass added thickness to planes, this decomposes a plane into fibers with different timelines. 2. PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.1, released on September 8, fixes Gsplat LOD empty levels for nodes without coarse data and distance defaults. Together with v2.22.0's error-driven GSplat LOD, per-splat detail falloff for streamed GSplats, and SceneDepthReader, SOG density, empty levels, and load progress become expressive inputs. 3. Babylon.js 9.26.0, released on September 10, includes an OpenUSD WebAssembly scene loader, object ID geometry textures, and Gaussian splatting stream diagnostics in Inspector V2. These fit the idea of returning asset origin, selection ID, and stream health to visible material. 4. three.js #34153 discusses inline tone mapping and output color-space conversion for single-pass WebGPU XR rendering, while #34147 discusses multiview providers and attachments in the WebGL fallback. Both are about reducing per-eye passes, resolves, and attachments, which connects to ribbon and LOD staging. 5. Codrops Liquid Glass remains relevant: SDF glass, video refraction, MSDF label deformation, and GPU cloth provide the thickness vocabulary for today's ribbon split and ID diagnostic surfaces.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable examples and why they matter
sections.body: Infinite Loom の面白さは、見た目は画像スライダーでも、実体は ribbon geometry / random seed / edge tear / fragment alpha の組み合わせになっている点。共有頂点のある1枚板を細分化すると膜のように伸びるが、独立リボンにすると隙間が開き、時間差が形になる。これは SOG / point cloud / object ID buffer と近い。「1枚の絵」ではなく、「多数の素片が同じ絵に見えているだけ」と考えると、LOD低下、stream遅延、片目resolve、readback詰まりを作品の破綻ではなく、ほどける演出として扱える。Liquid Glass も同じく、本物の厚みではなく shader 内の距離場と屈折で質感を作る。最近の流れは、WebGL/WebGPU の最適化や診断値を、隠すのではなく素材化する方向に寄っている。
sections.bodyEn: Infinite Loom is interesting because it looks like an image slider, but it is really ribbon geometry, random seeds, edge tearing, and fragment alpha. A subdivided single plane with shared vertices stretches like a membrane; independent ribbons create gaps and make time offsets visible. This is close to SOG, point clouds, and object ID buffers. If an image is not one image but many fragments temporarily agreeing to look like one, LOD reduction, stream delay, per-eye resolve, and readback congestion can become unraveling effects rather than failures. Liquid Glass similarly uses shader distance fields and refraction instead of real thickness. The recent trend is to materialize optimization and diagnostic values instead of hiding them.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命案は「Ribbon SOG LOD Unweave」。画像をリボン化し、端やポインタ周辺でほどける量を変える。そこへ PlayCanvas v2.22 系の Gsplat LOD / empty coarse level / streamed detail falloff を重ね、読み込みが安定している部分は鮮やかに織られ、coarse data がない部分は赤橙の欠落ノイズとして見えるようにする。短期では procedural image と疑似LODで十分。中期では SOG chunk event、LOD level、distance error、SceneDepthReader を texture 化する。派生案は「Object ID USD Stream Scope」。Babylon.js 9.26.0 の object ID geometry textures、OpenUSD loader、Inspector stream diagnostics を、選択ID・USD chunk・stream health の3層にして、作品制作中の裏側を1枚の診断映像へ変える。
sections.bodyEn: The main idea is Ribbon SOG LOD Unweave: turn an image into ribbons and change how much it unravels near the edges or pointer. Overlay PlayCanvas v2.22's Gsplat LOD, empty coarse levels, and streamed detail falloff: stable loading appears woven and vivid, while missing coarse data appears as red-orange absence noise. Short term, procedural images and fake LOD are enough. Mid term, feed SOG chunk events, LOD levels, distance error, and SceneDepthReader as textures. The derived idea is Object ID USD Stream Scope: turn Babylon.js 9.26.0 object ID geometry textures, OpenUSD loader state, and Inspector stream diagnostics into three layers of selection ID, USD chunks, and stream health.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: リボン分割は、1枚の plane を細分化するより、strip ごとに独立した頂点列を持たせる方が破れ・隙間・アルファ制御を作りやすい。shader 側では threadId / stripIndex を seed にして drift、flutter、fade、whiten を変える。SOG LOD と接続するなら、空 coarse level、distance error、fallback LOD、streamed detail falloff を RGBA state texture にして、R=stability、G=loaded detail、B=distance error、A=age のように割り当てると扱いやすい。XR では single-pass / multiview / attachment resolve の差分を、左右目のリボンずれや scanline density として出すと、技術差が見える演出になる。Babylon.js 側の object ID geometry textures は、pick / selection / segmentation を postprocess へ渡すだけでなく、色分解、輪郭、異常検知、stream diagnostics の素材として使える。
sections.bodyEn: For ribbon splitting, independent vertex strips are more controllable than subdividing a single plane, because tearing, gaps, and alpha can be controlled per strip. In the shader, use threadId / stripIndex as seeds for drift, flutter, fade, and whitening. To connect with SOG LOD, pack empty coarse level, distance error, fallback LOD, and streamed detail falloff into an RGBA state texture: R=stability, G=loaded detail, B=distance error, A=age. In XR, single-pass, multiview, and attachment resolve differences can appear as per-eye ribbon offsets or scanline density. Babylon.js object ID geometry textures can drive not only picking and segmentation but also color splitting, outlines, anomaly detection, and stream diagnostics.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 継続案件: 9/10 の Liquid Glass / readback pool / inspector surface は、今日の ribbon split と object ID plate の素材として継続。PlayCanvas v2.22 系は Gsplat LOD、SceneDepthReader、RenderTarget origin、MRT independent blending、volumetric fog をまとめて追う。新規案件: Babylon.js 9.26.0 の OpenUSD WebAssembly scene loader、object ID geometry textures、Gaussian splatting stream diagnostics in Inspector V2、IBL Shadows on ShadowOnlyMaterial。three.js は #34153 の WebGPU XR single-pass と #34147 の WebGL multiview provider を XR 表現の負荷削減候補として見る。寝かせる案件: GUI FlexPanel / em-rem units、iOS ringer workaround は有用だが、このスレッドのシェーダー・空間演出軸からは一段遠い。
sections.bodyEn: Continue yesterday's Liquid Glass / readback pool / inspector surface as material for today's ribbon split and object ID plate. For PlayCanvas v2.22, keep Gsplat LOD, SceneDepthReader, RenderTarget origin, MRT independent blending, and volumetric fog together. New items: Babylon.js 9.26.0 OpenUSD WebAssembly loader, object ID geometry textures, Gaussian splatting stream diagnostics in Inspector V2, and IBL Shadows on ShadowOnlyMaterial. For three.js, watch #34153 WebGPU XR single-pass and #34147 WebGL multiview provider as XR load-reduction candidates. Park GUI FlexPanel / em-rem units and iOS ringer workaround for now.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: まず `outputs/2026-09-11_ribbon_sog_lod_unweave.html` を開く。1 はリボン分解、2 は LOD stability、3 は multiview split、4 は合成。ドラッグでほどける中心、クリック/Space で stream pulse を入れる。次に足すなら、procedural image の代わりに過去の日次サンプル canvas や動画を貼り、LOD state texture で各リボンの drift / alpha / whiten を制御する。2本目の `outputs/2026-09-11_object_id_usd_stream_scope.html` は、1 object-id plate、2 USD chunk、3 Inspector stream diagnostics、4 合成。次に足すなら、実際の pick ID、USD load progress、SOG stream diagnostics JSON を uniform texture にする。
sections.bodyEn: First open `outputs/2026-09-11_ribbon_sog_lod_unweave.html`. Mode 1 is ribbon decomposition, 2 LOD stability, 3 multiview split, and 4 composite. Drag changes the tear focus; click / Space emits a stream pulse. Next, replace the procedural image with past daily sample canvases or video, then use an LOD state texture to control each ribbon's drift, alpha, and whitening. The second sample, `outputs/2026-09-11_object_id_usd_stream_scope.html`, shows 1 object-id plate, 2 USD chunks, 3 Inspector stream diagnostics, and 4 composite. Next, feed real pick IDs, USD load progress, and SOG stream diagnostics JSON as uniform textures.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: ネタ収集: Codrops Infinite Loom / Liquid Glass、PlayCanvas v2.22.1 / v2.22.0、Babylon.js 9.26.0、three.js #34153 / #34147。アイデア検討: 9/10 の glass / readback / inspector を、リボン分解、SOG LOD、object ID、USD stream へ接続。サンプル実装: 本命 `2026-09-11_ribbon_sog_lod_unweave.html` と派生 `2026-09-11_object_id_usd_stream_scope.html` を作成。結果の検証: JSON parse、HTML parse、gallery build、upsert publish を実行する。短期: procedural shader だけで ribbon / LOD / ID診断の見え方を詰める。中長期: 実SOG、USD、pick buffer、XR multiview、audio band、過去サンプル texture を同じ state-visible surface へ統合する。
sections.bodyEn: Collection: Codrops Infinite Loom / Liquid Glass, PlayCanvas v2.22.1 / v2.22.0, Babylon.js 9.26.0, and three.js #34153 / #34147. Ideation: connect yesterday's glass / readback / inspector to ribbon decomposition, SOG LOD, object ID, and USD stream. Implementation: created `2026-09-11_ribbon_sog_lod_unweave.html` and `2026-09-11_object_id_usd_stream_scope.html`. Verification: run JSON parse, HTML parse, gallery build, and upsert publish. Short term: refine ribbon / LOD / ID diagnostics with procedural shaders only. Mid term: merge real SOG, USD, pick buffers, XR multiview, audio bands, and past sample textures into one state-visible surface.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 最近の傾向は、単なる派手な shader ではなく「レンダリングの都合そのものをどう見せるか」に寄っている。9/4-9/7 は submit、readback、owner slot、TAA、AppStats、probe bake が処理の譜面だった。9/10 はそれを glass / cloth / inspector plane にした。今日はさらに、画像を繊維へ分解し、LODやIDやstream healthで織り直す段階。組み合わせ候補は、Infinite Loom の ribbon split x PlayCanvas Gsplat LOD x Babylon object ID x three.js XR single-pass。育てる価値が高いテーマは「ほどける診断面」。失敗や負荷を隠すのではなく、織り目、欠落、左右目差、ID色、chunk ring として舞台化できる。
sections.bodyEn: The recent trend is not simply flashy shaders, but how rendering constraints themselves become visible. September 4 to 7 treated submit, readback, owner slots, TAA, AppStats, and probe bake as a process score. September 10 turned that into glass, cloth, and inspector planes. Today decomposes images into fibers and rewrites them with LOD, ID, and stream health. A strong combination is Infinite Loom ribbon split x PlayCanvas Gsplat LOD x Babylon object ID x three.js XR single-pass. The high-value theme is unraveling diagnostic surfaces: failures and load are staged as weave, absence, eye difference, ID color, and chunk rings.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 本命として `outputs/2026-09-11_ribbon_sog_lod_unweave.html` を実装した。依存なし raw WebGL fragment shader で、procedural image を20本程度の水平リボンへ分割し、edge tear、pointer focus、SOG LOD stability、empty coarse level 風ノイズ、multiview split を合成する。短時間で見るポイントは「LODの欠落や粗密が、単なるエラーではなくほどける素材として読めるか」。派生として `outputs/2026-09-11_object_id_usd_stream_scope.html` も実装した。object ID plate、USD chunk ring、Inspector stream diagnostics を重ね、Babylon.js 9.26.0 の新要素をシェーダー診断面の方向へ試した。
sections.bodyEn: The main prototype is `outputs/2026-09-11_ribbon_sog_lod_unweave.html`, a dependency-free raw WebGL fragment shader that splits a procedural image into about twenty horizontal ribbons and combines edge tear, pointer focus, SOG LOD stability, empty-coarse-level-like noise, and multiview split. The quick question is whether LOD absence and density can read as unraveling material rather than errors. The derived prototype is `outputs/2026-09-11_object_id_usd_stream_scope.html`, layering object ID plates, USD chunk rings, and Inspector stream diagnostics to test Babylon.js 9.26.0 ideas as shader diagnostic surfaces.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ考察
sections.titleEn: Possibilities for the sample data and combinations
sections.body: 今日の2本は、render state をログ化するとかなり育てやすい。1本目は pointer、tear focus、ribbon id、LOD stability、empty coarse flag、pulse、mode を保存できる。音反応なら低域を ribbon drift、中域を LOD回復、高域を白抜けやRGBずれへ割り当てるとライブ向き。WebXR では左右目の resolve / multiview 状態を ribbon の位相差にできる。2本目は object id、USD chunk progress、stream diagnostic row、pool hit/miss、selection heat を保存できる。MediaPipe やカメラ入力を使うなら、手や顔の領域だけ ID plate を熱くし、背景はUSD chunkとして遅れて追従させると、実写と診断情報が同じ画面で混ざる。展示・VJ・プロダクト演出では「状態が乱れるほど画がほどけ、回復すると織り直される」という分かりやすい演出軸になる。
sections.bodyEn: Both samples become more useful if render state is logged. The first can save pointer, tear focus, ribbon id, LOD stability, empty coarse flag, pulse, and mode. For audio response, map low bands to ribbon drift, mids to LOD recovery, and highs to whitening or RGB offset. In WebXR, per-eye resolve / multiview state can become ribbon phase difference. The second can save object id, USD chunk progress, stream diagnostic row, pool hit/miss, and selection heat. With MediaPipe or camera input, heat only the hand or face region in the ID plate while the background follows as delayed USD chunks, mixing live video and diagnostics. For installations, VJ, and product experiences, the clear motif is: the image unravels as state becomes unstable, then weaves itself back together as it recovers.
